name: Bowie House Hotel
positioning: Bowie House, Auberge Collection: a Western-meets-modern hotel in Fort Worth's Cultural District, filled with its owner's personal art collection
best_for: Travelers who want a base in Fort Worth's Cultural District, near its museums and Dickies Arena
Art lovers drawn to a hotel filled with its owner's personal collection
Couples looking for a spa, a terrace pool with cabanas and suites with soaking tubs

facts.text: Bowie House is at 3700 Camp Bowie Boulevard in Fort Worth's Cultural District, near the city's museums, Will Rogers Memorial Center and Dickies Arena.
The hotel merges the classic Western personality of Texas with a decidedly modern feel.
Owner Jo Ellard, who breeds championship horses at her ranch outside Fort Worth, teamed up with Dallas-based BOKA Powell to design and furnish the hotel.
All guest rooms feature personalized bar carts, lounge spaces and original artwork.
Balcony Studios have a private balcony for morning coffee outdoors.
The Goodnight Suite has a living room, a dining room and a bedroom with a king size bed.
Ash Spa is a full-service spa with massages, facials and wellness treatments, an infrared sauna, a steam room and a relaxation lounge.
Ash Spa has a couples' suite with a private shower.
Bricks and Horses is the hotel's signature indoor-outdoor restaurant, pairing down-home Texas cuisine with city sophistication.
The Mulberry Room is the hotel's library, with a large bourbon collection and monthly gatherings.
The Billet Room hosts weekly game leagues, from cowboy bingo to billiards tournaments.
Cribs, highchairs, children's menus and third-party babysitting are available.

highlights.text: The hotel is filled with works of art personally collected by owner Jo Ellard, and a complimentary art walk showcases the collection.
A second-floor outdoor terrace pool is surrounded by garden views, with private cabanas and poolside dining and drinks from Whinny's.
Ash, an Auberge Spa, sits on the hotel's second floor and is inspired by the barns of Texas.

Each Studio nods to Texas living with hat racks, boot benches, boot jacks and leather-wrapped furniture; Lofts and Suites add touches such as pantries, powder rooms, free-standing soaking tubs and even a fireplace.
The centerpiece of The Bar at Bowie House is a vintage bar Ellard sourced from an auction house in Waco, Texas.

considerations.text: Bowie House is approximately 28 miles, or 35-40 minutes, from Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.
The Fort Worth Stockyards are not on the doorstep; they are approximately four miles away.
